jobs_results.title: Data Analyst (Job Vacancy)
jobs_results.description:
The 
Data Analyst
 plays a crucial role in our organization, driving data-driven decision-making and contributing to the overall success of the team. This position offers an exciting opportunity for collaboration, innovation, and professional growth within a dynamic environment.

As a 
Data Analyst
, you will be responsible for transforming raw data into actionable insights that inform strategic initiatives. Your analytical skills will help shape our business strategies and enhance operational efficiency.


Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to identify trends and patterns that support business objectives.

Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that provide stakeholders with real-time insights into key performance indicators.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and deliver tailored analytical solutions.

Utilize statistical methods to interpret data and generate useful business insights that drive decision-making.

Present findings and recommendations to management and stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner.

Monitor data quality and integrity, ensuring accuracy and reliability in all analyses.

Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in data analysis and visualization techniques.

Assist in the development of data governance policies and procedures to enhance data management practices.

Support ad-hoc analysis requests from various departments to facilitate informed decision-making.

Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process optimization through data analysis.


To excel in this role, candidates should possess a strong foundation in data analysis and visualization tools, as well as a passion for leveraging data to drive business success.


Bachelors degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

Proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL, Python, or R.

Experience with data visualization software like Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, to convey complex data insights effectively.

Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

Familiarity with statistical analysis techniques and methodologies.

Experience in data cleaning and preparation processes.

Knowledge of database management systems and data warehousing concepts.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


This role not only offers the chance to work with cutting-edge data technologies but also provides a platform for personal and professional development within a forward-thinking organization.

jobs_results.title: Senior Analyst
jobs_results.description: Branch Overview  Branch is a leading AI-based lending fintech with 50M+ downloads across India and Africa. We use alternative data to reach millions of people that are largely excluded from the financial sector. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with operations in India, Nigeria and Kenya, Branch is a for-profit, socially conscious company built for scale and impact. Our mission-driven teamfounded and led by the former CEO of Kiva.orgnow spans 400+ employees globally. Were backed by investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Visa, and the IFC. Job Description  Were looking for a Senior Analyst who can turn data into actionable insights that drive user growth, engagement, and profitability. Youll work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, & Business teams to identify opportunities, design experiments, and influence key business decisions. Responsibilities  Data driven Decisioning  Champion a data-first culture by enabling business teams to make informed, evidence-based decisions across Product, Growth, Collections, and Customer Experience. Translate business questions into structured analyses, ensuring that every strategic or operational choice is backed by quantitative insights. Partner with leadership to design metrics and success criteria for key initiatives, ensuring clear alignment between business goals and measurable outcomes Evaluate and communicate the impact of data-led interventions, using storytelling and visualization to drive executive alignment and action. Product Analytics  Work with Product Managers and Engineers to design and analyze A/B tests that improve user experience and business outcomes. Develop dashboards and reporting to track feature adoption, conversion rates, and user behavior. Provide data-driven recommendations to shape product roadmap and customer journey design. jobs_results.title: Operations Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Avaya is looking for a Operations Analyst to join its Dehradun team. You will turn raw operational data into clear, trustworthy analysis, and work directly with the people who use it to run the business.

About the role
This Operations Analyst role is hands-on and delivery-focused. Expect to spend your time analysing operational data to remove bottlenecks and improve throughput, working primarily in Excel, SQL and Power BI. You will own your outputs end to end — from the data pull and the sanity checks to the final recommendation.

Key responsibilities
• Track operational KPIs, SLAs and productivity metrics
• Investigate process bottlenecks and quantify their cost
• Build operational dashboards and daily performance reports
• Recommend and measure process improvements
• Work with ops leads to close gaps found in the data
• Validate and reconcile numbers before they are published, and document known data caveats
• Automate recurring reporting so the team spends its time on analysis rather than refreshes
• Present findings to non-technical stakeholders in clear, plain language

Required skills and tools
• Advanced Excel
• SQL
• Process Analytics
• KPI & SLA Tracking
• Power BI
• Root Cause Analysis
• Capacity Planning
• Data Visualization
• Reporting
• Problem Solving
• Coordination
• Communication

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech/BBA/B.Com/MBA/B.Sc or an equivalent degree. Candidates from any recognised university are welcome.
• Graduation year: 2023–2026 batches. Freshers and final-year students awaiting results may apply.
• Minimum 60% / 6.0 CGPA in the highest qualification (indicative — strong practical skills can offset this).
• Experience: 0–3 years in analytics, reporting, MIS or a closely related function.
• Technical skills: Advanced Excel, SQL, Process Analytics, KPI & SLA Tracking, Power BI, Root Cause Analysis.
• Soft skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, stakeholder communication, ownership and the confidence to flag a number that looks wrong.

Salary and compensation
• Annual CTC: ₹3,20,000 – ₹7,10,000 per year (3.2 LPA – 7.1 LPA), an indicative market range for this role in Dehradun.
• Monthly equivalent: approximately ₹43,000 per month at the mid-point of the range.
• Currency: INR (₹).
• Performance bonus / variable pay as per Avaya's policy, reviewed annually.
• The exact offer is confirmed by Avaya based on your interview performance and current compensation.

Perks and benefits
• Annual performance bonus / variable pay
• Health insurance for you and your dependants
• Provident Fund and statutory benefits
• Structured onboarding and mentorship
• Learning & certification support (SQL, Power BI, Tableau, cloud)
• Paid leaves and public holidays
• Flexible / hybrid working options
• Modern analytics tooling and licensed BI seats

Location, work mode and employment type
• Location: Dehradun, Uttarakhand
• Work mode: Hybrid
• Employment type: Full-time, permanent
• Working hours: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, Monday to Friday
• Number of openings: 4
• Joining: immediate to 60 days, as per your notice period

Selection process
• Round 1 — Resume screening and profile shortlisting by the talent acquisition team
• Round 2 — Technical interview 1 — SQL joins, aggregations, window functions and data modelling
• Round 3 — Case study / take-home assignment on a real dataset, with a walkthrough of your approach
• Round 4 — HR discussion — compensation, notice period, joining date and offer roll-out

Who should apply
Candidates from B.E./B.Tech/BBA/B.Com/MBA/B.Sc or an equivalent degree with up to 3 years of relevant experience who are based in Dehradun or willing to relocate. You should be comfortable with Advanced Excel, SQL, Process Analytics and able to explain your analysis to someone who has never seen the data. Portfolio projects, Kaggle work, a GitHub repo or published dashboards strengthen an application, especially for early-career candidates.

Why join Avaya
Working at Avaya means modern tooling, clean processes and colleagues who will review your logic properly. Analysts here grow into senior, lead and specialist tracks. High performers move into senior and lead analyst roles, take ownership of a business vertical, or specialise in data science, data engineering or product analytics. You will leave every year of this role with process changes with a measured before-and-after.

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not signed in you will be asked to log in or create a free MyInternships.in candidate account first, after which you will be taken directly to Avaya's official careers page to submit your application. Applications close on 19 September 2026 and are reviewed on a rolling basis, so apply early.

Additional information
• Documents required at the interview stage: updated resume, degree certificates or provisional certificate, and government photo ID.
• Experienced candidates should also carry recent payslips and a relieving or experience letter.
• There is no service bond for this position, and no equipment deposit is taken.
• A laptop and licensed analytics tooling are provided by Avaya for office and hybrid roles.
• Avaya and MyInternships.in never charge a fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. If anyone asks you for money in the name of this job, do not pay — report it. Responsibilities: Track operational KPIs, SLAs and productivity metrics; Investigate process bottlenecks and quantify their cost; Build operational dashboards and daily performance reports; Recommend and measure process improvements; Work with ops leads to close gaps found in the data; Validate and reconcile numbers before publishing, and document data caveats; Automate recurring reporting to free up time for real analysis; Present findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Requirements: B.E./B.Tech/BBA/B.Com/MBA/B.Sc or an equivalent degree from a recognised university; 0–3 years of experience in analytics, reporting or MIS — freshers and 2026 graduates are welcome; Working knowledge of Advanced Excel, SQL, Process Analytics; Comfort with Excel, SQL and Power BI and with cleaning messy, real-world data; Ability to define a metric precisely and explain a result to a non-technical stakeholder; Attention to detail, ownership and the discipline to document your work; Based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand or willing to relocate.

jobs_results.title: Junior Data Analyst Intern
jobs_results.description:
HighLevel is hiring a Junior Data Analyst Intern in Haridwar — a hands-on, mentor-led internship built for students and 2026 freshers who want real exposure to data analytics and business reporting rather than a certificate-only programme.

About the role
As a Junior Data Analyst Intern at HighLevel, your core focus will be supporting senior analysts on recurring reports, data validation and first-pass analysis. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve.

What you'll do day to day
• Work on supporting senior analysts on recurring reports, data validation and first-pass analysis alongside the core team
• Use SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling on live, production-facing problems
• Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers
• Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive
• Collaborate across functions — engineering, product, design or business as the work demands
• Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards
• Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan

Skills you'll build
You will build practical, demonstrable experience in SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling, Data Visualisation, Descriptive Statistics, Dashboard Design, Business Reporting, Problem Solving — the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished résumé, and every one of these skills is taught on the job.

Who should apply
Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), BCA/MCA, B.Com or BBA/MBA based in or willing to work from Haridwar. You should be willing to learn SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory.

Internship details
This is a 2-month internship in Haridwar, Uttarakhand, with a stipend of ₹15,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with ownership of a recurring report and an analysis a manager acted on. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion.

Expect to leave with real project experience, exposure to professional tooling and process, and mentorship that helps you plan a concrete next step in your career. Outstanding interns can convert to a full-time offer at the end of the internship.

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), BCA/MCA, B.Com or BBA/MBA
• Graduating batch: 2026, 2027 or 2028 — final-year students and recent graduates are both eligible
• Academics: 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; consistent academics help, but a strong project or portfolio is weighed alongside marks
• Technical skills: SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling
• Also useful: Data Visualisation, Descriptive Statistics, Dashboard Design, Business Reporting, Problem Solving
• Soft skills: clear written and spoken English, ownership of your work, comfort asking questions, and the discipline to check your own work before you ship it
• Experience: none required — this is a fresher internship. Academic projects, certifications, GitHub work or a previous internship strengthen an application but are not mandatory
• Location: based in Haridwar, Uttarakhand or willing to work from there for the internship period

Additional information
• Joining date: immediate / rolling — selected candidates usually start within 2-4 weeks of accepting the offer, and start dates can be adjusted around end-semester exams
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, standard business hours with 2-3 days a week in the office
• Duration: 2 months, with a certificate issued on successful completion
• Documents at joining: college ID or degree certificate, a government photo ID, and a No-Objection Certificate from your college where your programme requires one
• Equipment: a workstation and tool access are provided at the office; you will need your own laptop and a stable internet connection on work-from-home days
• Bond: no bond and no service agreement is attached to this internship
• Fees: HighLevel and MyInternships.in never charge a candidate any fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. Report anyone who asks you for money in the name of this internship

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to HighLevel's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Work on supporting senior analysts on recurring reports, data validation and first-pass analysis alongside the core team; Apply SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas) to live, production-facing problems; Document your work clearly for reviewers and stakeholders; Participate in reviews and act on the feedback you receive; Collaborate across engineering, product, design or business as required; Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), BCA/MCA, B.Com or BBA/MBA; Graduating batch 2026, 2027 or 2028 — final-year students and recent graduates welcome; 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; strong project work is considered alongside academics; Working knowledge of SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Exposure to Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling, Data Visualisation is an advantage; Clear written and verbal communication in English, and care with detail in your work; No prior work experience required — this is a fresher-friendly internship; Based in Haridwar, Uttarakhand or willing to work from there for the internship period.

jobs_results.title: Hiring: Marketing Data Analyst Yamuna Nagar (India)
jobs_results.job_title: Hiring: Marketing Data Analyst Yamuna Nagar (India)
jobs_results.description:
About FREED   

FREED is India's first comprehensive debt relief platform, built on the belief that financial freedom is a right, not a privilege. Since 2020, we have helped thousands of individuals take control of their financial lives, with ₹1,500 Crore+ in debt enrolled, 30,000+ customers served, and 10,000+ accounts resolved.   

Founded by Ritesh Srivastava and backed by leading investors, FREED is a fast-growing, purpose-driven fintech organisation on a mission that matters.   

About the Role   

Marketing team at FREED function runs on attribution, funnel, and content performance data spread across SEO, paid, lifecycle, and brand. This role owns the analytics layer connecting that data to decisions. You won't just build dashboards, you'll tell us what to do differently because of them.   

What you need   
3+ years in an analyst role, ideally marketing or growth analytics   
Robust SQL (joins, window functions, CTEs, not just SELECT *)   
Power BI: building from scratch, not just consuming templates. DAX proficiency required   
Comfort with ambiguous asks. Stakeholders will give you a vague question,you need to figure out the actual question   
Ability to say \"this metric doesn't mean what you think it means\" when it's true   

Good to have   
Exposure to fintech, lending, or debt resolution domain   
Python/R for anything Power BI can't do   
Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership (quick iteration, no hand-holding)   

What we don't want   
Someone who builds dashboards nobody asked for and nobody reads   
Someone who treats SQL as the ceiling instead of the floor   

Why FREED?   

Join India's first debt relief platform and lead a function that directly impacts the lives of individuals working towards financial freedom. At FREED, you'll have the chance to build, scale, and shape Customer Success in a fast-growing, purpose-driven fintech organisation.
